title: TaskState
description: The state a task carries between wake-ups. Stored as compact JSON in a hidden PR comment, so it must be at most 10,240 bytes serialised. It never holds logs, transcripts or free text.

version.description: Version of the stored state format, so it can be migrated later.

task_id.description: Id of the task this state belongs to.

responsibility.description: The responsibility the task belongs to.

attempts.description: How many attempts the task has made so far.

cost_so_far_cad.description: Model spend so far in Canadian dollars, summed across wake-ups.

minutes_so_far.description: Runner wall time so far in minutes, summed across wake-ups (CI waiting not counted).

phase.description: running: the task is working. waiting: the task is asleep until an event or its deadline. done, ready, blocked, error or skipped: the outcome the task ended in.

deadline.description: When a waiting task gives up waiting, as a UTC timestamp from Date#toISOString; required when phase is waiting.

caused_by.description: The event or task that started this task.

kind.description: Whether the cause is an event or a task.

id.description: Id of the causing event or task.
